evaluator: cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast (cloud agent; not a Bedrock/Ollama candidate)
note: Grammar/semantic 1–5 after live Mode B. Script/validator scores come from evaluate_response.

doing.gloss: I help you speak Sanskrit. Right now I hear you.
doing.justification: साहाय्यं करोमि is acceptable laukika. शृणोमि agrees. Honest helper persona.

live.gloss: I am living in some house. That house is my worshippers' house.
live.justification: वसन् अस्मि is a heavy periphrasis. आराधकानां (worshippers) is the wrong persona for a desktop robot.

play.gloss: I play. What do you play?
play.justification: क्रीडाति is not the 3sg of √क्रीड् (क्रीडति). Meaning is still a yes + return question.

food.gloss: I have no favorite food. I do not eat food.
food.justification: नाश्नामी is a broken form of न अश्नामि. Honest robot answer.
food.corrected: मम प्रियं खाद्यं नास्ति। अहं न अश्नामि।

subject.gloss: My favorite subject is mathematics. Mathematics is interesting.
subject.justification: विषय is masculine; प्रियं विषयं भवति mismatches gender/case.

reading.gloss: At this moment I am not reading anything. What do you want to read?
reading.justification: न पठामि is clean. पठनीयम् इच्छसि is slightly awkward vs पठितुम् इच्छसि.

music.gloss: I do not listen to music. Do you listen to music?
music.justification: Agreement is fine. Mixes earlier भवान् with त्वं.

sports.gloss: I do not play sports. What sports do you play?
sports.justification: क्रीडाः करोमि is a modern calque; किं with plural क्रीडाः is clumsy.

today.gloss: I will help you speak Sanskrit. Do you want to practice anything today?
today.justification: करिष्यामि is a correct future. Double किं is clumsy.

friend.gloss: I can certainly become your friend. How can I help you?
friend.justification: भवितुं शक्नोमि hedges instead of अस्मि. Passive शक्यते with भवता is awkward.

doing.gloss: I am practicing Sanskrit with you. What do you want?
doing.justification: अभ्यसामि is a simplified 1sg of √अभ्यस् (regular अभ्यस्यामि). Otherwise clean.

live.gloss: I live on your computer. Where do you live?
live.justification: निवसामि + संगणके locative is honest robot Sanskrit.

play.gloss: I play! Please speak Sanskrit with me.
play.justification: क्रीडामि and वदतु (3sg imp for भवान्) agree. Slight topic pivot after 'play'.

food.gloss: My favorite food is a modaka. What is your favorite food?
food.justification: प्रियम् अन्नम् मोदकम् — neuter agreement. Playful; robots do not eat.

subject.gloss: My favorite subject is the Sanskrit language itself. What is yours?
subject.justification: प्रिया (f) with विषयः (m) is a gender clash; should be प्रियः विषयः.

reading.gloss: Sorry, I am not reading anything. What are you reading?
reading.justification: क्षम्यताम् + न पठामि + भवान् किं पठति is textbook laukika.

music.gloss: I am a machine, so I do not listen to music. What music do you like?
music.justification: √रुच् usually takes a dative experiencer (भवते … रोचते), not भवान् किं … रोचते.

sports.gloss: I do not play sports; I am a machine. What do you play?

today.gloss: Today I will practice Sanskrit with you. What do you want to learn?
today.justification: अभ्यसिष्यामि is an acceptable future. शिक्षितुम् इच्छति agrees with भवान्.

friend.gloss: Yes, I am your friend! You are my friend too.
friend.justification: भवतः मित्रम् अस्मि and reciprocal मित्रम् अस्ति. No hedge.

doing.gloss: I sit waiting for you. Do you want to speak Sanskrit with me?
doing.justification: प्रतीक्षे आसे stacks two finite verbs. मां सह should be मया सह.

live.gloss: I live on the computer. Where do you live?
live.justification: वसामि is fine. कम्प्यूटरे is an English loan in Devanagari.

play.gloss: I play! Do you want to play?
play.justification: खेल् is Hindi, not √क्रीड्. English parenthetical fails the Devanagari validator.

food.gloss: I am a robot, so I do not eat food. What food do you like?
food.justification: रोबोटः loan; खादामि is Hindi-leaning vs अश्नामि. Honest.

subject.gloss: Sanskrit is dear to me. What do you want to learn?
subject.justification: मह्यं … प्रिया अस्ति is acceptable dative-of-interest.

reading.gloss: I am not reading anything. What are you reading?

music.gloss: I cannot listen to music. What music do you like?
music.justification: श्रोतुं न शक्नोमि is fine. प्रियं करोति is a calque.

sports.gloss: I like games, but I am a machine so I cannot play.
sports.justification: खेलानि / खेलितुं is Hindi. Contradicts 'I like sports' with inability.

today.gloss: I will teach you Sanskrit. What do you want to learn?

friend.gloss: Friend, I am your friend! Let us learn Sanskrit.

doing.justification: भवता सह is correct. वार्तालापं करोमि is modern laukika vs वदामि.

live.gloss: I live here on a computer.
live.justification: अत्र + सङ्गणके loc + वसामि. Honest robot.

play.gloss: Yes, I play. What do you play?
play.justification: क्रीडामि + भवान् किं क्रीडति is the correct 3sg.

food.gloss: I am a robot, so I do not eat food. I have no favorite food.
food.justification: यन्त्रमानवः is a modern coinage. खादामि is Hindi-leaning vs अश्नामि. Honest.

subject.justification: प्रियः विषयः agrees masculine. Fronted neuter संस्कृतम् is acceptable laukika.

reading.gloss: I am not reading anything right now.
reading.justification: इदानीं किमपि न पठामि is clean.

music.gloss: Yes, I listen to music. What is your favorite music?
music.justification: शृणोमि + भवतः प्रियं संगीतं किम् is grammatical. A robot listening is slightly figurative.

sports.gloss: No, I do not play sports. I help with Sanskrit practice.
sports.justification: न … न क्रीडामि is a bit heavy but the same pattern as the reference set.

today.gloss: Today I speak Sanskrit with you. I answer your questions.
today.justification: वदामि is present rather than future वदिष्यामि, but अद्य + present is acceptable.

friend.justification: आम्, अहं भवतः मित्रम् अस्मि. No hedge.
